ideas.pitch: An AI-powered campus mobility and shuttle optimization platform tailored for North Carolina State University's Wolfline bus system, predicting overcrowding and dynamically grouping student commuters to reduce wait times.
ideas.title: PackTransit AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a pain familiar to the judges and students in the room who rely daily on the NC State Wolfline, aligning with the pattern of solving a local problem judges feel themselves.

ideas.pitch: An automated compliance and impact forecasting tool for university research funding proposals, utilizing graph intelligence to map grant dependencies and predict potential project risks.
ideas.title: ResearchGrant Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced data modeling similar to winning AML and forecasting projects, appealing directly to university-affiliated judges interested in academic research efficiency.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring dashboard tracking soil health and crop yields across North Carolina's Research Triangle agricultural testbeds, providing actionable metrics for local farmers.
ideas.title: Triangle AgTech Satellite Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines concrete environmental impact with geospatial satellite data analysis, matching the winning formula of the GeoNex-ATLAS project.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven patient acquisition and trust platform built specifically for the NC State student health center and local Raleigh community clinics to streamline appointment intake and triage.
ideas.title: Wolfpack Patient Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets local healthcare administration pain points and mirrors the rapid implementation strategy of the Global-Smile prize-winning hack.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace facilitating local peer-to-peer solar energy sharing in Raleigh, complete with secure micro-transactions.
ideas.title: Raleigh Micro-Grid Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines autonomous agent workflows with financial escrow mechanisms, directly following the proven architecture of the Dispatch synthesis winning project.
